def get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target: str) ->Tuple[List[
    Dict[str, Any]], List[str]]:
    ctx = SafetyContext()
    
    if scanning_target == 'stdin':
        packages = ctx.packages
        if not packages:
            msg = 'No found packages in stdin'
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': msg}]], [msg]
        items = []
        names = []
        for pkg in packages:
            items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': pkg.name}])
            names.append(pkg.name)
        return items, names
    
    elif scanning_target == 'file':
        file = ctx.params.get('file', None)
        if file:
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file.name}'}]], [file.name]
        return [], []
    
    elif scanning_target == 'files':
        files = ctx.params.get('files', [])
        items = []
        names = []
        for f in files:
            items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {f.name}'}])
            names.append(f.name)
        return items, names
    
    elif scanning_target == 'environment':
        scanned_full_path = ctx.scanned_full_path
        if not scanned_full_path:
            msg = 'No locations found in the environment'
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': msg}]], [msg]
        items = []
        names = []
        for path in scanned_full_path:
            items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {path}'}])
            names.append(path)
        return items, names
    
    return [], []

def build_using_sentence(account: Optional[str], key: Optional[str], db:
    Optional[str]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if account:
        return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using your '}, {'style': True, 'value': 'account'}, {'style': False, 'value': ' and '},
                {'style': True, 'value': 'API key'}, {'style': False, 'value': ' provided'}]
    
    if key:
        return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using your '}, {'style': True, 'value': 'API key'}]
    
    if db:
        if is_a_remote_mirror(db):
            return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using a remote mirror: '}, {'style': True, 'value': db}]
        else:
            return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using a local database: '}, {'style': True, 'value': db}]
    
    return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using the default database'}]

        action_executed
    ] + [nl] + scanned_items_lines + [nl] + [using_sentence] + [scanned_count_sentence] + [timestamp]
    
    add_warnings_if_needed(brief_info)
    
    if as_dict:

            'safety_version': get_safety_version(),
            'scan_target': scanning_target,
            'scanned': [i[0].get('value', '').replace('-> ', '') for i in scanned_items],
            'api_key': bool(ctx.key),
            'local_database_path_used': ctx.params.get('db', None),
            'timestamp': now,
            'packages_found': len(packages),
            'policy_file': policy_f_name,
        }
    
    return brief_info
